svg.text: Positions from the street end, on the centre line of the 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 11 mm holes at 230 and 280 mm, countersunk on the outer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face for M10 countersunk bolts (through the post);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5 mm holes at 40 and 300 mm, tapped M6 (enclosure screws).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat on the outer side face of the rear right post, level,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 1,520 and 1,780 mm up; the bolts' heads must sit flush

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the enclosure's back lies flat on both rails.
